run_f_classif: run ANOVA F-value scoring to rank features for classification tasks
run_chi2: run chi-squared statistical test on non-negative features for classification
run_f_regression: run univariate linear regression tests returning F-statistic and p-values
run_r_regression: run Pearson correlation coefficient scoring for each feature and target
build_select_kbest: build a feature selector that keeps the top k highest scoring features
build_select_percentile: build a feature selector that keeps features above a score percentile
build_select_fdr: build a feature selector using Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate control
build_select_fwe: build a feature selector controlling family-wise error rate for multiple testing
build_generic_univariate_select: build a configurable univariate feature selector with percentile k_best fpr fdr or fwe mode
